name: Street Performer
summary: A crowd-savvy entertainer who uses misdirection, comedy, disguise, and social guile to protect allies.

features.name: Disappearing Act
features.summary: Make creatures that fail a Will save treat one chosen ally as invisible.
features.scaling: one additional protected creature at 5th and every 6 levels thereafter

features.name: Harmless Performer
features.summary: Enemies targeting you must save or lose that attack, or make a concentration check to redirect a spell.

features.name: Madcap Prank
features.summary: Force a nearby target to save each round or suffer a random one-round mishap: blinded, dazzled, deafened, entangled, prone, or nauseated.

features.name: Slip through the Crowd
features.summary: Let creatures protected by Disappearing Act move through crowds and enemy squares and function as if under greater invisibility.

features.name: Gladhanding
features.summary: Earn twice the normal Perform income and use Bluff to improve a creature's attitude briefly, after which it worsens.

features.name: Streetwise
features.summary: Add half Bard level to Bluff, Disguise, Knowledge (local), Sleight of Hand, crowd-influence checks, and gathering information.

features.name: Quick Change
features.summary: Don a disguise as a standard action at -5, take 10 on Bluff and Disguise, and create a diversion as a swift action; periodically take 20.
features.scaling: take 20 once per day plus once per 6 levels after 5th
